Turkey Bois

Shotgun-powered flight, procedural forests, and one pilgrim who is never full.

View on SteamSee the game
01 / The game

Built around a mechanic you can explain in one sentence.

Turkey Bois is a cooperative arena shooter where recoil is movement, the map changes between runs, and feeding the pilgrim means surviving a forest full of armed turkeys together.

Developer and publisher — Metater · Game systems · Online co-op

01

Recoil is traversal

Every shotgun blast doubles as movement, turning combat into aerial routing and recovery.

Procedural runs

Changing forest layouts keep navigation, enemy pressure, and co-op decisions fresh.

Proximity voice
